scores.visual_critic_note: Clean typographic controls and intentional blend-mode on links show design awareness, but the circle pack is visibly clipped at the bottom of the viewport — the dominant circle extends beyond the SVG bounds, failing the 'does it work at rendered size' gate.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Core encoding is honest — scaleSqrt correctly used for node-size in force layout, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, key functions on node and link joins — but hierarchyLinkSelection lacks a key function and the partition sunburst's scaleSqrt radial scaling subtly distorts ring-size comparisons without documentation.
scores.stress_test_note: Two un-throttled redraw paths and missing .interrupt() guards are the primary robustness gaps; no infinite-loop or mouse-touch-fight issues detected.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 300 bundled edges at default opacity create a dense visual mass in the dominant red cluster that overwhelms the default (uninteracted) state, but hover/click highlight-and-fade interaction recovers clarity; animation congruence across 8 layout morphs cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
flags: Update Storm: tension-slider fires redrawLinks() (300 path joins) on every input event without RAF throttling
Update Storm: easing-params slider input restarts a 1500ms svg.transition() on every mousemove
Mid-Flight Snap: updateLayout() creates a new svg.transition() without calling .interrupt() first — relies on D3 implicit interruption, leaving a gap where mid-flight tweens and new tweens overlap

Stale Closure: linkSelection / hierarchyLinkSelection are module-level lets reassigned per regenerateAndRender(); a re-generate during an in-flight tween lets the old tween's redrawLinks() operate on the new selection

proposer: Same line count. The change: links are now colored by their source node's group color at 15% opacity with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, making the edge bundles legible as colored streams between clusters rather than a uniform gray tangle. Highlight interaction preserves the source color instead of overriding with amber. Faded state is more aggressive (4% opacity) for better contrast when hovering.
